final: WITH patient_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), fractions AS (SELECT ID, examination_count, CAST(examination_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(examination_count) FROM patient_counts) AS fraction FROM patient_counts), average_fraction AS (SELECT AVG(fraction) AS avg_fraction FROM fractions) SELECT ID, examination_count, fraction, fraction - avg_fraction AS excess FROM fractions CROSS JOIN average_fraction WHERE fraction > avg_fraction ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
